title: CouponsCouponExpiredPayload
description: coupons.coupon.expired v1 (OpenVibe.Coupons server/domain/coupons.js recompute, payload from lifecyclePayload). A code's status became expired, in the transaction that recorded it: the sweep (server/worker.js, every COUPONS_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS) saw its known expiry pass (reason expiry), a recompute for other work found it past its expiry first (evidence, report or decay), or staff or a service marked it expired (staff, service:<client>[:<note>]). Active lists do not wait for this event: they filter on expires_at at query time. When the code was in Search, a coupons.index_document.deleted tombstone and the merchant's updated document follow in the same transaction. Envelope: subject { type: coupon, id: cpn_… }, visibility public when the code was publicly listed before the change, otherwise internal, priority important (not set: the Events default), actor service:coupons. No known consumers.

merchant_id.description: The merchant the code belongs to.

confidence.description: Report confidence at the time (rounded to 2 decimals); null = no counted report in the last 30 days.

expires_at.description: The known expiry that passed; null when staff or a service marked a code of unknown expiry expired.

canonical_url.description: The code's page on Coupons (<origin>/c/<coupon id>); it stays up, noindex.

previous_status.description: Status before; a disabled code has to be re-enabled before it can be marked expired.

reason.description: expiry, evidence, report, decay, staff, or service:<client>[:<note>].

anyOf.description: service:<client id>, plus :<note> (at most 200 characters, copied verbatim) when the service gave one.
